stories.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status (recruiting, active, completed, terminated, unknown) and explicitly map all known ClinicalTrials.gov status values into this contract, including a fallback category for unmapped values.
